description:
Scholarship overview

This Massey scholarship supports food-related doctoral research in New Zealand. It is designed for graduates who completed Massey's Food Technology honours degree through a Singapore tertiary institution. The annual value combines stipend, tuition and research funds rather than representing cash living support alone.

Research Areas

  • Food technology
  • Food research
  • Nutrition-related research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryNZD 50,000/year total package: stipend, tuition and research funds
DurationThree years
Payment basisTotal annual package includes tuition and research funds; cash stipend is not separately stated

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityEligible Massey Singapore Food Technology graduates
Academic preparationMassey Food Technology (Hons) degree completed through a Singapore tertiary institution, with admission to food-related doctoral study in New Zealand.
Further conditionsStudy in New Zealand; must hold Massey Food Technology (Hons) from a Singapore tertiary institution.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round1 November 2026
LocationNew Zealand

About Massey University

Massey offers doctoral research in science, food technology and other disciplines. Its scholarship portfolio includes alumni awards and subject-specific funding, with eligibility and application dates set out for each award.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Official Link

Full announcement and application portal: https://www.massey.ac.nz/study/scholarships-and-awards/massey-singapore-food-technology-phd-scholarship/

Source: massey.ac.nz - the details in this listing were recorded from this official page.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 1 November 2026 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
